text:
sanjay (Eng): Hey - my partner Priya had an outpatient visit yesterday and UnitedCare processed the claim as OUT-OF-NETWORK. Provider said they couldn't verify her under our plan because the last name on their intake is 'Patel' but her insurer record is under her maiden name 'Rao'. Claim #: 99660011. Has anyone seen dependent name mismatch issues?

zoe (People Ops): Yep, this happens sometimes when dependent legal name vs provider intake mismatches. Did you enroll her under Patel-Rao or Rao in the HR portal? Can you upload the EOB, digital ID screenshot, and enrollment confirmation here?

sanjay (Eng): Uploaded EOB.pdf, idcard.png, enrollment_confirm.png. In HR system she shows as "Priya Patel-Rao" but UnitedCare's member ID for her is UC-000990088 under "Priya Rao". The EOB lists patient as "Priya Patel" and says provider couldn't verify coverage so billed self-pay.

benefits-bot: Plan lookup: RW-PPO-2025 (UnitedCare). Member mapping note: dependent canonical ID UC-000990088. Common resolution: submit a name-correction / enrollment update to insurer + request claim reprocessing with proof of relationship. Member services: 1-800-555-9012, appeals portal: https://unitedcare.example/appeals.

zoe (People Ops): OK, proposed next steps: 1) HR will submit a dependent name correction to UnitedCare (we'll attach the enrollment record and marriage certificate/ID); 2) file a member claim reprocessing request with UnitedCare attaching EOB, enrollment confirmation, ID, and receipt; 3) broker will escalate if UnitedCare won't reprocess. Do you have a marriage certificate or state ID we can include?

linda (Broker): I can open an enrollment audit and force a retro reprocess once insurer accepts the name update. If provider won't resubmit with the corrected patient name, UnitedCare can re-adjudicate using the member's canonical ID and supporting docs. Please attach everything.

matt (Finance): If you paid out-of-pocket, Finance can approve a temporary advance up to $500 while the appeal is pending. DM me the receipt and amount.

sanjay (Eng): I paid $260 at the clinic. Uploading receipt.jpg and marriage_cert.pdf now. Also can you paste a short appeal text I can submit to UnitedCare portal?

zoe (People Ops): Use this and attach docs when you file or tell the rep on the phone:

```
To UnitedCare Member Services,

Please review Claim #99660011 for services dated 2025-05-04 billed by Midtown Outpatient Clinic for patient Priya Patel (dependent of Sanjay Patel, Member ID: [employee member id]). The dependent is enrolled as Priya Patel-Rao; UnitedCare's member record is under Priya Rao (UC-000990088). The claim was denied/processed as out-of-network due to a name mismatch. Attached: EOB, enrollment confirmation from Redwood HR, marriage certificate/state ID, clinic receipt. Please update the dependent record and reprocess the claim under the in-network contract, adjusting member responsibility accordingly.

Thank you,
[Member Name]
```

benefits-bot: Case created: UnitedCare Case UCARE-2025-0501-8899. Submitter: sanjay (Eng). Link: https://unitedcare.example/cases/UCARE-2025-0501-8899

zoe (People Ops): Logged internal ticket HR-BEN-765 and pinged HR benefits to submit the name correction. I'll cc you on the broker/insurer emails, and Linda will escalate if we don't get reprocessing within 7 business days.

sanjay (Eng): Thank you all! Really appreciate the fast help. Will update when I get the insurer case # or reprocess confirmation. :pray:
